title: Replace a todo item with PUT
goal: Clients that keep the whole item can send it back in one request instead of patching single fields.

acceptance_criteria.text: PUT /todos/:id with {"title", "done"?} replaces the item: the title is validated as on POST, done is false when it is left out, and the answer is 200 with the new item.
PUT on an id that does not exist answers 404 and creates nothing.
